title: 第11章  修为提升
content_zh:
楚山摇了摇头，忍不住开口道：“楚弛，你若是真能击败老四，我保证，整个楚家，没人敢再欺负你，你的地位，仅次于我！另外，我会给你一个惊喜。”
楚弛咧嘴一笑，自信地道：“爷爷，那我就等着你的惊喜。对了，请你给我一些淬体晶，我准备冲击隐脉。”
“哦？你要冲击凡人境四层了？这么快？好。我给你！”
很快，院子里，只剩下了楚弛一人。
他盘腿坐在槐树下，开始冲击第四条隐脉。
对别人来讲，十天时间，对付凡人境七层的修者，是痴人做梦。
但他不一定做不到。
再说了，如果他高看了自己的天赋，真的做不到，那时候再逃也不迟！
楚弛深知大丈夫能屈能伸的道理。
谁会傻到明知道不敌，还去故意送死啊。
“第四条隐脉，我来了！”
人体，隐脉无数。
想要打通隐脉，非常不容易！
就算长辈们告诉你，隐脉在什么地方，也只是一个大概的位置。
所谓差之毫厘谬以千里。
这时候，淬体晶就有了作用。
淬体晶，是凡人境修者，将隐脉里的灵气实体化，形成的晶体。
它能同体内的隐脉形成感应，主动引导灵气，前往隐脉所在的位置。
对于小家族来说，淬体晶还是很珍贵的。
因为每一次凝练淬体晶，都需要不短的时间。

淬体晶凝练成功后，还得修养很长一段时间。
一般都是家族的长辈，修为无法晋级，又闲来没事，才会凝聚淬体晶。
“淬体晶。吃！”
淬体晶下肚，立马转化成为独特的能量。
这股能量，牵引着楚弛体内的灵气，前往了身体某个隐秘的地方。
随后，停滞不前。
也就是说，这里就是第四条隐脉所在的位置。
“冲！”
楚弛二话不说，运转灵气，疯狂撞击。
每一次撞击，体内就排山倒海一般难受。
撞击了大概千次，一颗淬体晶的能量，就消耗殆尽了。
淬体晶的能量耗尽，对灵气的牵引作用就会消失。
楚弛正准备服用第二枚淬体晶，却发现《大道自然诀》自动运转了起来。
哪怕淬体晶的能量消失了，灵气也并未散去，依旧聚在一起，自动撞击第四条隐脉的端口。
一切，自然而然。
最让楚弛惊讶的是，那聚在一起的灵气，化为了细针。
那密密麻麻的细针，排成长队，像是游龙。
在细针疯狂的撞击下，嗤的一声响。
黑暗处，多出了一点光明。
那一层看不见的膜，终于被捅破了！

灵气顺着缺口快速涌入，一条发光的隐脉，出现在了体内。
第四条隐脉，成功打通。
楚弛明显感觉到自己的力量，变得更大了。
“凡人境四层了！比我想的还容易。”
楚弛非常惊讶，《大道自然诀》，居然还能用来冲击隐脉。
这是万物万事皆自然吗？
“哈哈，继续吸收天地灵气！”
楚弛闭上眼睛，再次吸收天地灵气。
但这一次四周聚集的灵气量，远远没有之前浓郁。
他的体质，虽然能让灵气快速聚集。
但，乡野之地，灵气稀薄，之前他吸收了那么多灵气，天地之力还没有将灵气恢复，所以，这一次灵气明显变少了。
之前，八个小时，灵气就能饱和，但这一次，八天都不一定能饱和。
“香蕉你个巴拉，我虽然天赋逆天，但大环境太差了啊！乡野小村，终究不是洞天福地。”
楚弛皱起了眉头。
虽然他现在是凡人境四层，想要对付光明拳小成的楚寻意，还是不稳妥。
最好是将修为提升到凡人境六层，就算六层同七层之间有一道坎，他也有自信，能轻松对付楚寻意。
那么，要怎样才能快速将修为再提升两层呢？
“灵药！”
楚弛眼神一亮，想要快速提升修为，只能依靠提升修为的灵药。
这种灵药，楚家没有。

但，楚弛知道，有一个地方有可能有。
那就是，野兽山岭。
野兽山岭很大，如果运气好，还是能寻到提升修为的灵药的。
他哥哥楚天，曾经就寻到了一株三色花。
三色花，可提升凡人境三层以下修者一层修为。
当时楚家是打算将这花给楚盈盈，却被楚弛偷了，送给了庞妃烟。
现在想想，他真对不起八妹。
“那就去一趟野兽山岭吧，就算没寻到灵药，要是能猎杀野兽，能得到兽丹，也能增强体内的灵气。
正好，看看能不能遇到我哥。他去野兽山岭，也有半个月了。”
想到就做，楚弛准备了几套衣服，离开了楚家。
在路过村里怡春院的时候，楚弛停下了脚步。
怡春院，大门紧闭，门上写着：暂时打烊。
楚弛下意识捏紧了拳头。
对于这个地方，他是有感情的。
毕竟，他是这里的常客。
只是站在门口，他似乎就看见了姑娘们在向他招手。
“七少爷，您又来了。快请进，你不是一直想要新人吗？今个，终于来了！而且，还是一对双胞胎！”
“七少爷，你都三天没来了，我还以为你外出了呢。”
以前，楚弛的存在感，只存在于大手大脚花银子的时候。
因为只有这种时候，他才有被人认可，被人拥戴的感觉。

只有这里的人，不排斥他。
只有这里的姑娘，需要他。
别人都以为他天性浪荡，实际上，这里，是他心灵的港湾。
别人，不懂。
楚弛叹了口气，朝院子里拜了三下。
这三下，拜那些死去的姑娘们！
青莲……野菊……绿萝……
每一个姑娘的名字，他都记得清清楚楚。
那一晚发生的事情，他同样记得清清楚楚。
“我不会让你们枉死的。绝对不会！”
轻喃了一声，楚弛正准备离开。
大门忽然咧开了一条缝，有人叫了一声：“七少爷……”
门缝后的人，虽然披头散发，楚弛还是认出来了对方是谁。
“龟婆！你没死？”
那一晚，在怡春院的所有姑娘，都死了。
按照道理来说，龟婆也不可能活。
“七少爷，进来说。”
龟婆小心
content_en:
Chu Shan shook his head and couldn't help but said: "Chu Chi, if you can really defeat the fourth child, I guarantee that no one in the entire Chu family will dare to bully you anymore. Your status is second only to me! In addition, I will give you a surprise."
Chu Chi grinned and said confidently: "Grandpa, then I'm waiting for your surprise. By the way, please give me some tempering crystals, and I'm going to attack the hidden veins."
"Oh? Are you going to hit the fourth level of the mortal realm? So soon? Okay. I'll give it to you!"
Soon, Chu Chi was the only one left in the yard.
He sat cross-legged under the locust tree and began to attack the fourth hidden vein.
For others, dealing with cultivators at the seventh level of the mortal realm in ten days is just a dream.
But he may not be able to do it.
Besides, if he overestimates his talent and really can't do it, then it's not too late to run away!
Chu Chi knows very well the truth that a man can bend and stretch.
Who would be so stupid as to deliberately risk death even though they know they are outmatched?
"The fourth hidden vein, here I come!"
The human body has countless hidden veins.
It is very difficult to open the hidden vein!
Even if the elders tell you where the hidden vein is, it is only an approximate location.
The so-called difference is a thousand miles.
At this time, the quenched crystal comes into play.
Tempered body crystals are crystals formed by cultivators in the mortal realm who materialize the spiritual energy in hidden veins.
It can sense the hidden veins in the body and actively guide spiritual energy to the location of the hidden veins.
For a small family, the tempered crystal is still very precious.
Because every time you condense the quenching crystal, it takes a long time.
After the quenching crystal is successfully condensed, it still needs to be cultivated for a long time.
Usually it is the elders of the family who cannot advance in cultivation and have nothing to do, so they can condense the body tempering crystal.
"Tempering crystal. Eat!"
The quenched crystal is immediately transformed into unique energy.
This energy pulled the spiritual energy in Chu Chi's body to a hidden place in his body.
Then, there was a stagnation.
In other words, this is where the fourth hidden vein is located.
"Charge!"
Without saying a word, Chu Chi circulated his spiritual energy and struck wildly.
Every impact made my body feel overwhelmingly uncomfortable.
After about a thousand impacts, the energy of a tempered crystal was exhausted.
When the energy of the quenching crystal is exhausted, its pulling effect on the spiritual energy will disappear.
Chu Chi was about to take the second tempering crystal, but found that the "Natural Art of the Great Dao" started to operate automatically.
Even if the energy of the quenching crystal disappeared, the spiritual energy did not dissipate. It still gathered together and automatically hit the port of the fourth hidden vein.
Everything comes naturally.
What surprised Chu Chi the most was that the gathered spiritual energy turned into thin needles.
The densely packed fine needles lined up in a long line, like a swimming dragon.
Under the crazy impact of the fine needle, there was a hissing sound.
In the darkness, there is a little more light.
That invisible membrane was finally broken!
Spiritual energy quickly poured in along the gap, and a glowing hidden vein appeared in the body.
The fourth hidden vein was successfully opened.
Chu Chi clearly felt that his strength had become stronger.
"It's the fourth level of the mortal realm! It's easier than I thought."
Chu Chi was very surprised that "The Natural Art of the Great Dao" could actually be used to attack hidden veins.
Is this all natural?
"Haha, continue to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth!"
Chu Chi closed his eyes and absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth again.
But this time, the amount of spiritual energy gathered around him was far less dense than before.
Although his physique can quickly gather spiritual energy.
However, in the countryside, spiritual energy is thin. He had absorbed so much spiritual energy before, and the power of heaven and earth had not restored the spiritual energy, so this time the spiritual energy was obviously reduced.
Before, the spiritual energy could be saturated in eight hours, but this time, it may not be saturated in eight days.
"Banana, you bastard, although I am extremely talented, the environment is too bad! A rural village is not a paradise after all."
Chu Chi wrinkledfrowned.
Although he is now at the fourth level of the mortal realm, it is still not safe to deal with Chu Xunyi, who has achieved a small degree of success in the Bright Fist.
It was best to upgrade his cultivation to the sixth level of the mortal realm. Even if there was a hurdle between the sixth level and the seventh level, he was confident that he could easily deal with Chu Xunyi.
So, how can we quickly increase our cultivation level by two levels?
"Elixir!"
Chu Chi's eyes lit up. If he wanted to quickly improve his cultivation, he could only rely on the elixir to improve his cultivation.
This kind of elixir is not available in the Chu family.
However, Chu Chi knew that there was a place where it was possible.
That is, Beast Ridge.
The Beast Mountain Range is huge, and if you are lucky, you can still find elixirs that can improve your cultivation.
His brother Chu Tian once found a tricolor flower.
The three-color flower can improve the cultivation level of cultivators below the third level of the mortal realm.
At that time, the Chu family planned to give the flower to Chu Yingying, but Chu Chi stole it and gave it to Pang Feiyan.
Thinking about it now, he was really sorry for Bamei.
"Then go to the Beast Mountain. Even if you don't find the elixir, if you can hunt the beasts and get the beast elixir, you can also enhance the spiritual energy in your body.
Just in time, let's see if we can meet my brother. It has been half a month since he went to Beast Mountain. "
He did whatever he thought of, Chu Chi prepared a few sets of clothes and left the Chu family.
When passing by Yichun Courtyard in the village, Chu Chi stopped.
The door of Yichun Courtyard is closed, and it says on the door: Temporarily closed.
Chu Chi clenched his fists subconsciously.
He has feelings for this place.
After all, he is a regular here.
Just standing at the door, he seemed to see the girls waving to him.
"Seventh Young Master, you are here again. Come in quickly, haven't you always wanted someone new? This one is finally here! Moreover, they are twins!"
"Seventh Young Master, you haven't been here for three days. I thought you were out."
In the past, Chu Chi's presence only existed when he was spending money lavishly.
Because only at this time can he feel recognized and supported by others.
Only the people here don't reject him.
Only the girl here needs him.
Others think he has a dissolute nature, but in fact, this place is the harbor of his soul.
Others don't understand.
Chu Chi sighed and bowed three times toward the courtyard.
These three times, worship those dead girls!
Green lotus... wild chrysanthemum... pothos...
He remembered every girl's name clearly.
He also remembered clearly what happened that night.
"I won't let you die in vain. Absolutely not!"
With a soft murmur, Chu Chi was about to leave.
The door suddenly opened a crack, and someone called out: "Seventh Young Master..."
Although the person behind the door was disheveled, Chu Chi still recognized who he was.
"Gitou Po! You're not dead?"
That night, all the girls in Yichun Courtyard died.
Logically speaking, it is impossible for Turtle Woman to survive.
"Seventh Young Master, come in and talk."
Turtle woman, be careful
